about: Which kinds of outlet endorse candidates in an editorial (owner, Oct 16: papers endorse, "if it happens in real life, sure"). An outlet of a kind listed here weighs the races on its beat (outletWeighsRace in src/core2/modules/campaigns.ts); the rest report on races and endorse no one.
source: Newspapers and opinion magazines have long endorsed candidates on their editorial pages. Broadcast stations largely stopped: the FCC's political editorial rule (47 CFR 73.1930) required a licensee that endorsed a candidate to offer the rivals reply time, and stations stopped endorsing rather than give the time; the rule was repealed in 2000 and the practice did not come back. Cable news networks and online-only outlets do not endorse as institutions.
